concepts.name: Live surface id wins over a projected Claude stamp
concepts.description: Surface detection treats CURSOR_AGENT as Cursor even when a Claude adapter projection exported L9_GOVERNANCE_SURFACE=claude-code.
concepts.problem: A projected Claude surface id on a Cursor session activates Claude-only PreToolUse wrappers and scores the wrong runtime.
concepts.semantic_contract: surface_detect.py / surface_detect.sh resolve the live surface from CURSOR_AGENT and explicit ids; a projected claude-code or claude-code-remote value does not outrank an active Cursor agent marker.
risks: Treating the projected env as authority would keep Cursor inside Claude gates.

acceptance_tests.given: CURSOR_AGENT is set and L9_GOVERNANCE_SURFACE is claude-code

beneficiary_fit.merge_decision: refresh AGENTS.md with the live-surface override

concepts.name: l9_hook_exec skips Claude-only wrappers on Cursor
concepts.description: The Claude adapter hook runner is shared; Cursor must not execute Claude PreToolUse wrappers that belong to a different gate plane.
concepts.problem: Running local_execution_gate_wrap and memory_gate on Cursor duplicates or fights beforeShellExecution.
concepts.semantic_contract: l9_hook_exec skips only local_execution_gate_wrap.py and memory_gate.py when the resolved surface is not Claude; merge_gate_wrap.py and session_debt_wrap.py remain.
risks: Skipping merge_gate_wrap would drop merge-denial from the adapter path.

beneficiary_fit.merge_decision: index the hook-exec skip as adapter architecture

concepts.name: Surface identity is detected, not inherited from projection
concepts.description: The autonomy surface id used by gates must come from live process markers, not from files a Claude projection wrote.
concepts.problem: A stale projected surface id silently moves a Cursor session onto Claude gate law.
concepts.semantic_contract: Gate skip and kernel latch decisions consume surface_detect output. A projected L9_GOVERNANCE_SURFACE is evidence, not identity, when CURSOR_AGENT is set.
risks: An explicit non-Cursor L9_GOVERNANCE_SURFACE must still win when CURSOR_AGENT is unset.

acceptance_tests.given: an explicit L9_GOVERNANCE_SURFACE other than projected Claude ids
acceptance_tests.then: the explicit id is the resolved surface
